[Gentlemen](/organisation/135),
I am greatly obliged for the copies of [Mrs](/person/549) & [Miss Gatty](/person/494)’s Books. I find that my not having sooner received the former ones was owing to my directions for the forwarding of parcels to me me [sic] not having been attended to. I am sorry that I have thus been the innocent cause of so much inconvenience and of having thus received more than my due of copies.
yours faithfully

C M Yonge
